summary: Quote and Depth on an NFO future: Upstox's incremental full packets are merged into the instrument's snapshot, so an LTPC-only packet, a minute-candle-only packet and a book-only packet each keep what they do not carry; volume is vtt and close the previous close.

notes: Values are the audit's P-01/P-02 probe values (WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_PRIMARY_BROKERS.md).

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; the web's Upstox payload has no mode key.
The web's Upstox frames carry the subscription's broker token (the instrument key); the desktop's do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.

The web stamps Upstox Quote and Depth frames with the broker's currentTs; the desktop stamps its receipt time (audit P-02, still open: the Upstox decoder should carry FeedResponse.current_ts, receipt time only when it is absent).
Upstox sends OI as a double; the web passes it on as a float (98765.0), the desktop sends the whole contract count (98765), as every other broker's OI and the docs' integer OI are.
The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest for every broker, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter sends oi only.

Upstox's book has no order counts: the web's levels carry price and quantity only and its book carries the broker's currentTs as depth.timestamp; the desktop's levels carry orders 0 (an invented zero, the 1.0.6 known limitation) and no book timestamp. Lane wire: leave orders out where the broker sends none.
